name: Time Out Market
note: Straight from the airport: lunch at the stalls, then drop the bags.

name: Apartment, Rua do Norte
note: Two nights in Bairro Alto. Keys in the lockbox, code in the booking email.

name: Praça do Comércio
note: Walk down Rua Augusta and through the arch.

name: Sé de Lisboa
note: The cathedral. The cloister is worth the ticket.

name: Castelo de São Jorge
note: Closes at 18:00 in November. Buy tickets online to skip the queue.

name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
note: Sunset over the Alfama roofs and the river.

name: Tasca do Chico
note: Fado and petiscos. No bookings, so go early.

name: Pastéis de Belém
note: The original custard tarts. Eat in the back rooms; the takeaway queue is longer.

name: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
note: Book a timed ticket. Saturdays sell out by noon.

name: Torre de Belém
note: A walk along the river. Outside is enough if the queue is long.

name: LX Factory
note: Lunch, then the bookshop Ler Devagar.

name: MAAT
note: Walk on the roof for the view. Tickets at the door.

name: Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara
note: Take the Glória funicular up.

name: Cervejaria Ramiro
note: Seafood, then the steak sandwich for dessert. No bookings: arrive before 20:00 or queue.

name: Manteigaria
note: Warm pastéis de nata straight from the oven.

name: Tram 28 at Martim Moniz
note: Board at the first stop to get a seat. Ride to Graça.

name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
note: The highest viewpoint in the city.

name: Panteão Nacional
note: Climb to the dome terrace.

name: A Cevicheria
note: Under the giant octopus. Expect a short wait.

name: Jardim do Príncipe Real
note: Coffee under the cedar, then the shops on the square. Airport at 17:30.
